nom: Vanicream Moisturizing Cream with Pump Dispenser

avis.texte: This cream is a lifesaver for us. Our young child has always had sensitive skin, basically every product we tried irritated his skin. We were using only aquaphor and even that was bothersome, he said it hurt and was itchy. We brought him to a dermatologist who recommended Vanicream and gave us a sample, saying it is one of the most gentle things you can use, and also advised on really dry skin to always use a "cream" not a "lotion" or "moisturizer". The sample application went well, no complaints or talk or itch. Before the sample was finished, I came to Amazon to get a full size. I was pleased with the price! I expected it to cost more but it's a great value. The lotion itself is pretty versatile as I have been putting it on his face and body and have had zero issues or breakouts on his face, even though it isn't a facial moisturizer per say. Overall, the size and amount of product you get is good. I absolutely love this product. It has absolutely zero fragrance to it which is nice for the extra sensitive, and it also allows our entire household to use it. It isn't oily at all but it still a nice thick creamy feel to it. It absorbs into the skin quickly and quite well, again no residual oils or product. When we upkeep this, his skin is soft and no itching or rashes. It truly has been a game changer for us.

avis.titre: Great for sensitive skin on face and body
avis.texte: I bought this cream because I was looking for something new to try for aging sensitive skin. If you have very dry skin or you have sensitive skin, I do highly recommend this lotion. It works for the face and the body, and I do love an all-purpose product. For myself, I ended up going back to my regular lotion face and body lotion because it was a little too thick for me for the summer (I sweat easily), but perhaps I’ll try it again in the colder weather when the air is dryer and I’m not sweating just stepping out of the shower. I do think that it absorbed relatively quickly even though it may not feel like it. It is challenging to apply because it is thick and a little bit goes a long way. It requires a little extra massaging to get it into the skin, but it did its job moisturizing my skin. It is totally safe if you have sensitive or red-prone skin. I was using it on my face and my body and had no issues for the time that I was using it. I also think it is a good value for the money. Since a little bit goes a long way, the tub you buy will last you for a long while. My choice to go back to my original routine is definitely not because I think the product is faulty. I will continue to keep it at my bedside table and use it on my hands and feet before I go to bed.

avis.titre: A Lifesaver for Sensitive Skin – But Very Thick!
avis.texte: If you have sensitive skin, eczema, or struggle with reactions to most lotions, Vanicream Moisturizing Skin Cream is an absolute game-changer! It’s fragrance-free, dye-free, and formulated without common irritants, making it one of the best moisturizers I’ve ever used. 🌿 ✨ Perfect for Sensitive & Dry Skin – This cream soothes irritation, calms redness, and provides deep hydration without causing breakouts or burning. avis.titre: Reliable, gentle, and great for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I’ve been using this Vanicream moisturizer for about a year now after researching alternatives to another popular brand, CeraVe, for sensitive skin. I’ve actually come to prefer this over its predecessor—it feels safer and more effective at keeping my skin moisturized without any irritation. I also use it on my 8-year-old, who has very sensitive skin, and it works beautifully for her too. It’s thick but not too heavy, absorbs well, and never causes breakouts. I appreciate the squeeze nozzle, which makes application cleaner and more convenient. I experimented by adding lavender essential oil to my last batch, and while the scent was lovely at first, it faded after about a week. I do wish it came with a naturally scented option, but I understand the unscented formula is ideal for sensitive skin—which is ultimately why I stick with it. Great value, dependable performance, and gentle enough for the whole family. This is my go-to moisturizer!

avis.texte: I saw this being recommended by an allergy specialist so I came here to look at the ingredients. NO WAY would I use this stuff on my skin on a regular basis! Just look at the ingredients it has: "white petrolatum, cetearyl alcohol and ceteareth-20, sorbitol solution, propylene glycol, simethicone, glyceryl monostearate, polyethylene glycol monostearate, sorbic acid and BHT." At least half of this stuff is very bad for one's body! Petrolatum is just what it sounds like. Great for running engines, not so great for a human body. And I know BHT is not a good thing. This just shows you how uninformed M.D.'s are, that they recommend this crap! They are very antiquated in their thinking, they never consider the ingredients in stuff and often recommend FDA-approved medicines that have high rates of severe complications including death. Don't accept that just because an M.D. recommends something, that it's really good for you, any more than a site selling allergy products knows what they are talking about when they recommend Vani-cream! I have upgraded my review to 3 stars based on EWG giving it a Score of 3 which is considered "low concern" or "low hazard".
